preserving.description: Uses splitlines, collects pairs in a list, builds the dict afterwards, and writes with four-space indentation.

files.solve.py:
import json

pairs = []
with open("app.env", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for raw in fh.read().splitlines():
        line = raw.strip(" \t")
        if line == "" or line[0] == "#":
            continue
        idx = line.index("=")
        key = line[:idx].strip(" \t")
        value = line[idx + 1:].strip(" \t")
        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] in ("'", '"') and value[-1] == value[0]:
            value = value[1:-1]
        pairs.append((key, value))

config = dict(pairs)

with open("config.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(config, fh, indent=4)
    fh.write("\n")

preserving.description: Reverses the line order so the first seen reversed entry wins, then writes keys in reverse insertion order with ensure_ascii off.

files.solve.py:
import json

result = {}
with open("app.env", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    lines = fh.read().split("\n")

for raw in reversed(lines):
    line = raw.strip(" \t")
    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
        continue
    key, _, value = line.partition("=")
    key = key.strip(" \t")
    value = value.strip(" \t")
    if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "\"'":
        value = value[1:-1]
    if key not in result:
        result[key] = value

with open("config.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    json.dump(result, fh, ensure_ascii=False)
    fh.write("\n\n")
